verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management product like Trello, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of retention settings, deletion workflows, or data-lifecycle controls. Community reports describe the opposite of user control: boards disappearing after an unannounced account change, and support offering only wholesale deletion after a 2FA lockout. With no vendor claim of the capability to contradict, this is 'none', not 'disputed'.
